Description: Tailwind v4 is imported with a regular CSS @import "tailwindcss" instead of the v3 @tailwind base/components/utilities directives. Configuration is CSS-first; a tailwind.config.js file is no longer detected automatically and is only read when loaded with @config. Check the installed major before applying v3 instructions.
Do: @import "tailwindcss" in the main stylesheet and configure in CSS
Don't: @tailwind directives or an unreferenced tailwind.config.js in a v4 project

Guideline: Register sources Tailwind cannot detect with @source
Description: v4 scans the project for class names automatically, except files in .gitignore, node_modules, binary files, CSS files and lock files. There is no content array or JIT setting to configure. Register ignored locations, such as a component library in node_modules, with @source paths relative to the stylesheet; @source not excludes paths and @source inline() safelists classes.
Do: @source "../node_modules/@acme/ui" for ignored paths that contain class names
Don't: Configure a v3 content array or purge option
Code Bad: module.exports = { content: ['./src/**/*.{html,js}'] } // v3 config, not detected automatically in v4

Description: Tailwind scans source files as plain text, so class names built by string concatenation or interpolation are never generated. Map each state to a complete class name.
Do: Map values to full class strings
Don't: Interpolate fragments into class names

Description: Theme variables declared in @theme (for example --color-*, --font-*, --breakpoint-*) generate matching utilities and are also exposed as CSS variables. This replaces theme.extend in tailwind.config.js; token values come from the project's own design decisions.
Do: @theme { --color-brand: ...; } then use bg-brand or var(--color-brand)
Don't: theme.extend in a JS config, or repeating bg-[var(--color-brand)] for a value that should be a token
Code Good: @theme { --color-brand: /* project value */; --font-display: /* project font stack */; } <!-- generates bg-brand, text-brand, font-display -->
Code Bad: module.exports = { theme: { extend: { colors: { brand: '...' } } } } // v3 config

Description: v4 uses native cascade layers, so custom utilities are declared with @utility instead of @layer utilities or a JS plugin. Utilities declared this way work with variants such as hover: and lg:.
Do: @utility name { ... } for a repeated custom declaration
Don't: @layer utilities { .name { } } or a config-file plugin for a simple utility

Guideline: Load plugins with @plugin; aspect ratio is core
Description: Official plugins such as @tailwindcss/typography (prose classes) and @tailwindcss/forms are loaded in CSS with @plugin. aspect-* utilities have been core since v3.0, so the @tailwindcss/aspect-ratio plugin is not needed, and container queries are core in v4.
Do: @plugin "@tailwindcss/typography"; in the stylesheet
Don't: Install @tailwindcss/aspect-ratio or register plugins in tailwind.config.js for a v4 project

Description: @apply inlines utilities into custom CSS; utility classes in markup remain the primary API. In Vue/Svelte <style> blocks or CSS modules, @apply and @variant need the theme, custom utilities and variants, so import the main stylesheet with @reference, which makes them available without duplicating CSS.
Do: Prefer classes in markup; use @reference before @apply in component style blocks
Don't: Rebuild every component with @apply, or @import the full stylesheet into each component style block

Description: By default dark: follows the prefers-color-scheme media query. For a manual or three-way toggle, override the variant in CSS with @custom-variant (darkMode: 'class' is v3 config). Set the class or data attribute from an inline script in <head> so the page does not flash the wrong theme.
Do: @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); toggle the class on <html> from an inline head script
Don't: darkMode: 'class' in a v4 project, or apply the theme class after first paint
Code Good: @import "tailwindcss"; @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); /* <head>: document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', localStorage.theme === 'dark' || (!('theme' in localStorage) && matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)) */
Code Bad: module.exports = { darkMode: 'class' } // v3 config, not detected automatically in v4

Description: v4 shifted several scales: shadow-sm is now shadow-xs and bare shadow is shadow-sm; the same applies to drop-shadow, blur, backdrop-blur and rounded. Bare ring is now 1px (ring-3 is the old width) and ring and border default to currentColor. The bare versions still work, but v3 code renders differently unless updated.
Do: Rename v3 classes to their v4 equivalents when upgrading
Don't: Copy v3 class names into v4 markup and expect the same rendering
Code Good: shadow-xs rounded-xs ring-3 /* v4 equivalents of v3 shadow-sm rounded-sm ring */
Code Bad: shadow-sm rounded-sm ring /* v3 meaning; renders differently in v4 */

Description: v4 removed utilities deprecated in v3: bg-/text-/border-/divide-/ring-/placeholder-opacity-* (use an opacity modifier such as /50 on the color utility), flex-shrink-* and flex-grow-* (use shrink-* and grow-*), overflow-ellipsis (text-ellipsis) and decoration-slice/clone (box-decoration-*).
Do: Opacity modifiers on color utilities; shrink-*, grow-*, text-ellipsis
Don't: bg-opacity-*, flex-shrink-*, overflow-ellipsis in v4

Description: v4 renamed bg-gradient-* to bg-linear-* and adds angles (bg-linear-45) and interpolation modifiers such as /oklch; the docs use bg-linear-* throughout.
Do: bg-linear-to-r bg-linear-to-b
Don't: bg-gradient-to-* (the v3 name)

Description: In v4 outline-none sets outline-style: none, while outline-hidden hides the outline but keeps it in forced-colors mode (v3's outline-none behavior). The docs recommend your own focus styling whenever the default outline is hidden; focus-visible: targets keyboard focus.
Do: Pair outline-hidden with a visible focus-visible: style
Don't: focus:outline-none with no replacement focus style

Description: Icon-only buttons and links need an accessible name. sr-only keeps text available to screen readers while hiding it visually; aria-label is an alternative.
Do: Visually hidden text or aria-label on icon-only controls
Don't: Icon-only button with no accessible name

Description: animate-* and transition utilities do not check prefers-reduced-motion by themselves. Use motion-safe: to apply motion only when the user has not asked for reduced motion, or motion-reduce: to remove or replace it.
Do: motion-safe:animate-* or motion-reduce:animate-none / motion-reduce:transition-none
Don't: Unconditional decorative animation
Code Bad: animate-pulse /* plays even when reduced motion is requested */

Guideline: hover: only applies on hover-capable devices
Description: In v4 the hover: variant is wrapped in @media (hover: hover), so tapping on a touch device no longer triggers hover styles. Treat hover as an enhancement and keep essential information and actions reachable without it.
Do: Make hover styles optional enhancements
Don't: Put required content or actions behind hover: only
Code Bad: Essential action

Description: Unprefixed utilities apply at every width; a prefixed utility such as md:text-base applies at that breakpoint and up. sm: means 'at the small breakpoint', not 'on small screens', so mobile styles are the unprefixed ones.
Do: Default mobile + md: lg: xl:
Don't: Desktop-first approach
Code Bad: sm:text-center /* only applies from the sm breakpoint up, not on small screens */

Description: v4 includes container queries: mark a parent with @container and style children with @sm:, @md: and similar variants, which apply at that container size and up. The @tailwindcss/container-queries plugin is not needed.
Do: @container on the parent and @md: variants on children
Don't: Install the container-queries plugin in v4, or use viewport breakpoints for component-internal layout

Guideline: Prefer gap for flex and grid spacing
Description: gap-* spaces flex and grid children without margins on each child. v4 changed space-x-*/space-y-* to set a margin on every child except the last; the upgrade guide suggests flex or grid with gap if that selector change causes issues.
Do: flex or grid with gap-*
Don't: Margins on each child, or space-y-* where children wrap or are conditionally hidden

Description: aspect-* reserves a box's proportions before media loads and object-cover/object-contain control how media fills it, preventing stretched images.
Do: aspect-* on the container or media plus object-cover / object-contain
Don't: Fixed width and height that distort media

Description: Handle long text gracefully
Do: truncate or line-clamp-*
Don't: Overflow breaking layout

Description: Style based on parent/sibling state
Do: group-hover peer-checked
Don't: JS for simple state interactions

Description: Square brackets take one-off values; v4 uses parentheses for CSS variables, so bg-[--x] (v3) becomes bg-(--x).
Do: w-[350px] for a one-off value; bg-(--brand-surface) for a CSS variable
Don't: Creating config for single use

Description: Single utility for equal width and height
Do: size-4 size-8 size-12
Don't: Separate h-* w-* for squares

Description: Add width/height attributes to SVGs to prevent layout shift before CSS loads
Do: <svg class='size-6' width='24' height='24'>
Don't: SVG without explicit dimensions
